scripts.mobile:sync: npm run mobile:build && npx cap sync android
scripts.mobile:run: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap run android
scripts.mobile:apk:release: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.mobile:aab:release: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.mobile:keystore:create: cd android && keytool -genkeypair -v -storetype PKCS12 -keystore app/financeflow-release-key.jks -alias financeflow -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000
